title: The 13th Animation Support Program Winners Showcase (anifest 2026)

title_lang.en: The 13th Animation Support Program Winners Showcase (anifest 2026)
title_lang.zh_hk: 第十三屆「動畫支援計劃」本地薑得獎馬拉松 (anifest動画藝術祭2026)

synopsis: This program features nine award-winning local animation shorts, including: The Nonsense Play, which uses absurdist storytelling to portray a school obsessed with grades; Frangipani, a delicate story of exploring redemption and reconciliation; We Will Rob You, a dark comedy satirizing modern the current society; BROC!, a fantasy story about two zombies transforming into humans; and The Light Chaser, an inspiring story about a small old-fashioned tow truck with big dreams.

synopsis_lang.en: This program features nine award-winning local animation shorts, including: The Nonsense Play, which uses absurdist storytelling to portray a school obsessed with grades; Frangipani, a delicate story of exploring redemption and reconciliation; We Will Rob You, a dark comedy satirizing modern the current society; BROC!, a fantasy story about two zombies transforming into humans; and The Light Chaser, an inspiring story about a small old-fashioned tow truck with big dreams.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 今屆動畫支援計劃挑選九部得獎佳作，展現出香港動畫師的創意和技巧。兩小無猜在校園《不軌劇場》看透荒誕日常，另一個飽受霸凌同學寄望《曦》望來臨，坐著《追光小拖車》追尋夢想。面對複雜大人世界，美女上司《袁小姐的每一天（動畫版）》受到型男工程師猛烈追求，帽子縫紉師同時《The Obsession》地迷戀舞台劇主角，與其成為《一擗泥》不停做炒散轉工，倒不如《打劫經濟》償還重重學債。最終去到喪屍世界，迎來一場《西蘭花事變》，靠《ROBOY - SURROUND SOUND》給人們帶來平靜和安慰。

director: Nic Ho, Smallook, Nikle Lai, Hung Kwan Yiu, Emil Yee, Eva Yang, Calvin Woo, Wong Chung Him, Shek Ka Chun, Wong Yan Yin, Chung Ching Yee, Lam Wai
